verdict.rationale: Persona's Workflows feature lets users define triggers that automatically tag risk, run additional reports, or ingest third-party data without manual intervention, and Reports can be scheduled to run on recurring intervals — both are genuine background automations. However, these are docs-only enterprise workflow/report configurations, not automation aimed at 'AI-native' users or exposed as an agent-friendly automation API. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-specific automation setup, independent/hands-on confirmation that workflows run unattended reliably, and any AI-native tooling around workflow creation.
